name: mint-demo
description: ItWorksinMyLocal#62's small PERSISTENT minting demo fleet: 3 oldxdc sealers (the trusted quorum) + 1 geth role:proposer candidate + 1 xone role:proposer candidate, both genesis-time masternodes (extraData + the seeded 0x88 SMC from block 1, same role:proposer mechanism as mint-iter). Unlike mint-iter* (wiped/rebuilt every gate iteration), this topology is meant to be brought up once and left running so its nodes are visible on stats.xdcindia.com as a live demo of geth-XDC and xone actually minting -- ethstats is on, and it is NOT part of any mint-gate scenario/assertion. Stable chainId, own portBase, own genesis; never torn down by scenario.sh or mintlab.sh.
